diagnosis.recommended_next_step: No se recibió una medición calibrada compatible; no afirmar corto ni ubicación.

area_hypothesis_fields.confidence_note: Confidence describes evidence support for an approximate board area, not certainty of a short or identification of a component.

constraints: No universal numeric cutoff: thresholds must be characterized for the exact adapter, calibration, source, protocol and tested model family.
Input-current onset timing is one feature only; it cannot spatially locate a fault by propagation delay alone.
Do not mark battery/display/charge-board areas excluded unless a valid test independently isolates that path.
A no-alarm result is not proof that no short exists.
The app does not directly probe USB data pins or apply power; the user's separately validated measurement hardware owns electrical safety and limits.
This contract does not define circuit construction, pin wiring, current-injection procedures, or service thresholds.
